# pve_sdn_zone_evpn (Data Source)

Reads an EVPN SDN zone from `GET /cluster/sdn/zones/{zone}`. Errors when the zone's upstream type is not `evpn`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_sdn_zone_evpn" "zone1" {
  zone = "zone1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The SDN zone object identifier to look up (2 to 8 characters, starting with a letter).

### Read-Only

- `advertise_subnets` (Boolean) Whether IP prefixes (Type-5 routes) are advertised instead of MAC/IP pairs (Type-2 routes) (PVE `advertise-subnets`).
- `controller` (String) ID of the primary BGP/EVPN controller (PVE `controller`) for this zone.
- `dhcp` (String) Name of the DHCP server backend for this zone (PVE `dhcp`). Must be one of: `dnsmasq`.
- `digest` (String) The read-only SDN configuration revision (PVE `digest`) of the zone section.
- `disable_arp_nd_suppression` (Boolean) Whether IPv4 ARP and IPv6 Neighbour Discovery messages are suppressed (PVE `disable-arp-nd-suppression`).
- `dns` (String) ID of the DNS API server (PVE `dns`) for this zone.
- `dnszone` (String) DNS domain zone for this zone (PVE `dnszone`).
- `exitnodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names (PVE `pve-node-list`) acting as exit nodes.
- `exitnodes_local_routing` (Boolean) Whether routes are created on the exit nodes so they can connect to EVPN guests directly (PVE `exitnodes-local-routing`).
- `exitnodes_primary` (String) Cluster node name (PVE `pve-node`) traffic is forced through first.
- `ipam` (String) ID of the IPAM (PVE `ipam`) managing IP addresses in this zone.
- `mac` (String) Anycast logical router MAC address (PVE `mac-addr`) for this zone.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the zone (PVE `mtu`), used for the created VNet bridges.
- `nodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names where this zone is created (PVE `pve-node-list`).
- `reversedns` (String) ID of the reverse DNS server (PVE `reversedns`) for this zone.
- `rt_import` (String) Comma-separated list of Route Targets (PVE `pve-sdn-bgp-rt-list`) imported into the VRF of this zone via BGP.
- `secondary_controllers` (List of String) Additional controller IDs (PVE `secondary-controllers`) peering with the primary controller.
- `vrf_vxlan` (Number) VNI for the zone VRF (PVE `vrf-vxlan`).
